title: Imaging mitochondria live or fixed muscle tissues
protocol: Reconstitute IraZolve-Mito powder with 55.1 µL of high-quality DMSO to prepare a 10 mM stock solution.
Store the IraZolve-Mito stock solution at 4°C.
Dilute the IraZolve-Mito stock solution in complete sterile DPBS to a final concentration of 20 µM (1:500 dilution).
Prepare fresh 20 µM IraZolve-Mito staining solution for each experiment.
Discard the IraZolve-Mito staining solution at the end of the experiment.
Dissolve 50 µg of MitoTracker Red CMXRos in 94 µL of high-quality DMSO to prepare a 1 mM stock solution.
Store the MitoTracker Red CMXRos stock solution at -20°C.
Avoid multiple freeze-thaw cycles for the MitoTracker Red CMXRos stock solution.
Dilute the MitoTracker Red CMXRos stock solution in complete DMEM media or DPBS at a ratio of 1:1000 for mitochondrial staining.
Discard the MitoTracker Red CMXRos staining solution at the end of the experiment.
To 4 g of PFA add 50 mL of distilled water.
Add 1 mL of 1M NaOH.
Heat and stir at 60 ºC to dissolve the mixture.
Once dissolved, add 10 mL of 10 × DPBS.
Adjust pH to 7.4 with 1M HCl.
Add distilled water to reach a final volume of 100 mL.
Filter the solution.
Store aliquots at -20 °C.
Dissolve 1 g of Saponin in 10 mL of sterile DPBS.
Store the saponin solution at 4 ºC.
For permeabilization, add 100 µL of 10% Saponin to 10 mL of DPBS.
Stirring continuously, dissolve 2.5 g of lyophilized BSA in 50 mL of sterile DPBS.
Add 250 µL of 10% Saponin to the BSA solution.
Disperse into 10 mL-aliquots.
Store blocking solution at -20 ºC.
For anti-Cytochrome C staining, add 2 µL of antibody stock in 1 mL of blocking solution.
Prepare secondary antibody by diluting Anti-Rabbit IgG conjugated with Cy5 at a ratio of 1:200 in blocking solution.
Store Hoechst 33258 stock solution at 4°C in the dark.
Dilute Hoechst 33258 stock solution at a ratio of 1:1000 in DPBS for nuclear staining.
Store diluted Hoechst solution in the dark.
Collect images for IraZolve-Mito using a 403 nm laser set to 2 power setting.
Detect emission between 505 and 625 with a spectral detector.
Set gain to 180 for cardiac tissue and 170 for skeletal muscle tissue.
For epifluorescence microscopy, excite IraZolve-Mito with UV/blue light sources.
Use a wideband pass filter or narrowband pass filter within the emission range of 550-650 nm.
For two-photon microscopy, excite IraZolve-Mito by wavelengths between 800-830 nm.
Image using a spectral detector set for emissions of 550-650 nm or a suitable red fluorophore emission filter.
Use a 561 nm excitation wavelength with 0.3 power setting for MitoTracker® Red CMXRos imaging.
Collect emission at 595 nm by a GaAsP PMT detector with gain of PMT HV 30.
Use the above settings sequentially to collect images of IraZolve-Mito and MitoTracker® Red CMXRos in co-staining experiments.
Image anti-Cytochrome C antibody staining using a 640 nm laser at 7 power setting.
Collect emission wavelength at 700 nm by a standard PMT with gain of PMT HV 125.
Use a 403 nm laser at less than 1.0 laser power for Hoechst 33258 DNA stain imaging.
Detect emission at 450 nm using a GaAsP PMT detector with gain of PMT HV 65.
Set the pinhole radius to 42.1 μm.
Use a 40X/WI λS DIC N2 water emersion lens for imaging.
Set the temperature in the imaging facility to a constant 19 °C.
Prepare the Zeiss LSM 710 META NLO inverted microscope for imaging.
Configure the two-photon Mai-Tai® tunable Ti:Sapphire femtosecond pulse laser with a wavelength range of 710–920 nm.

Set up the polychromatic multichannel detector (META spectral detector) with MBS-InVis: MBS 690+ and excitation wavelength at 740 nm, emission interval from 474 to 504 nm for endogenous fluorophore NAD(P)H.
Adjust the laser power to 11%.
Set the pinhole size to a maximum of 600 µm.
Configure the pixel dwell time to 1.58 µs and average each image eight times to increase signal-to-noise ratio.
Mount an LD C-Apochromat 40X/NA 1.1 Water Corr UV-VIS-IR M27 objective (Carl Zeiss, Germany) for imaging.
Humanely kill the animal via overdose of sodium pentobarbitone or CO₂ inhalation.
Remove cardiac muscle tissue from the left ventricle and skeletal muscle from the quadriceps.
Remove all fat and connective tissues from the collected samples.
Place collected live tissue samples into 70 mL specimen containers containing sterile DPBS.
Keep tissue samples on ice and protect from light.
Transport tissue samples to the imaging facility within 90 min.
Image tissue samples within 7 h after collection.
Cut tissue samples using a sharp scalpel to allow clean cutting and prevent damage associated with tearing of tissue.
Submerge tissue samples in 4% PFA for 20 hours at 4°C.
Remove PFA fixative and wash the fixed tissues in DPBS for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Store tissue samples in DPBS at 4°C until required.
Cut tissue sections to 2 mm thick by using a sharp scalpel in sterile DPBS.
Keep these tissue sections in DPBS for 2 hours at room temperature prior to staining.
Cut tissue samples into cubes less than 1 cm³.
Snap freeze tissue samples in liquid nitrogen at the animal facility.
Transport tissue samples on dry ice before storing them at -80°C.
Cut tissue sections on a cryostat at 5 μm-thick and collect onto charged glass slides.
Heat-fix tissue sections to slides at 60°C for at least 60 min.
Store slides at -20°C until required.
Submerge tissue samples in 1 mL of the IraZolve-Mito staining solution in 5 mL tubes.
Incubate at room temperature with gentle agitation for 30 min.
Aspirate the staining solution.
Wash tissues for 5 min in DPBS with gentle agitation.
Submerge tissue samples in 1 mL of the MitoTracker® Red CMXRos staining solution in 5 mL tubes.
Incubate on ice with general agitation for 15 min.
Aspirate the staining solution.
Wash tissues for 5 min in DPBS with gentle agitation.
Permeabilize 4% PFA fixed tissues with 0.1% Saponin in DPBS for 2 hours at room temperature.
Block non-specific binding of the antibody by submerging tissues in 5% BSA containing 0.05% Saponin for 2 hours at room temperature.
Incubate tissues with anti-Cytochrome C antibody (1 μg/mL, prepared in 5% BSA containing 0.05% Saponin) overnight at 4 ºC with gentle agitation on a rocker platform.
Wash tissues for 2 hours in DPBS.
Add secondary anti-IgG antibody conjugated with Cy5 labels and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash tissues for 2 hours in DPBS.
Stain tissues with Hoechst 33258 DNA stain (1:1000 in DPBS) for 1 minute.
Wash tissues for 5 minutes in DPBS.
Mount tissues for imaging using µ-slide 8 well chambers.
Keep tissues moist but avoid mounting in DPBS to prevent floating.
Place the longitudinal cross-section of tissues in contact with the chamber's imaging surface when possible.
Achieve good contact between the sample and the surface by gently pressing the tissue down into the chamber.
Use samples roughly the same size as the chamber to help hold the tissue in place.
Utilize a dissection microscope for placing and orienting the tissues.
Add an appropriate amount of mounting media, such as 80% glycerol in PBS, for snap-frozen tissue sections before adding a cover slip.
Place the µ-slide 8 well chambers on microscope stage.
Maintain constant 37 °C and 5% CO₂ for H9c2 cells.
Switch on the Uno-Combined-Controller, CO₂ microscope electric top stage incubation system.
Wait for 60 min to equilibrate the chamber before starting.
Start NIS Elements software.
Select 40X/WI λS DIC N2 water emersion lens from the list.
Focus on the sample through the microscope; use DIC.
Switch optical path to A1 and click “Remove Interlock” button.
Select a scan mode, Galvano.
Set 403 nm laser to 2 power setting for imaging.
Set emission between 505 and 625 detected by a 32 channel spectral detector.
Set gain to 180 for cardiac tissue and 170 for skeletal muscle tissue.
Set pinhole radius to 42.1 µm.
Avoid extended excitation of the sample.
Save images as ND2 file to maintain meta data.
Follow steps v, Section 7A for imaging MitoTracker® Red CMXRos.
Select 561 nm excitation wavelength with a power setting of 0.3 for imaging.
Set emission at 595 nm using a GaAsP PMT detector.
Set gain of PMT HV to 30.
Start Zen software and select LD C-Apochromat 40X/NA 1.1 Water Corr UV-VIS-IR M27 objective from the list.
Place µ-slide 8 well chambers on microscope stage.
Focus on the sample through the microscope; use transmitted light.
Switch on a two-photon Mai-Tai® tunable Ti:Sapphire femtosecond pulse laser and wait for 5-10 min before starting.
Select “Lambda scan” from the software.
Set the laser power to 11% and the pinhole to maximum 600 µm.
Collect images using two-photon excitation wavelength at 740 nm and a 474–504 nm emission interval.
Set the pixel dwell time to 1.58 µs.
Average each image eight times.
Save images in LSM file format.
